[home-security-services] Built 2026-09-29 without web search, because the search budget was used up. Pages were found by crawling each brand's homepage, sitemap.xml and help-center sitemaps, then fetched with WebFetch or curl. REVIEW PASS 2026-09-30 (second agent; web search also unavailable, and WebFetch hit its session limit partway through, so later checks used curl). The review re-fetched about 45 detailed entries' billing pages live. Alert 360 support articles, Ring billing, cancel and payment-method articles, Cove's portal-billing page, SimpliSafe's cancel/downgrade article, Frontpoint self-billing, and Xfinity autopay, history and paperless pages were added. Mail-payment addresses were added for TruGreen, Guardian Protection and Bay Alarm. Phone numbers were corrected or expanded for AHS, Cinch, Liberty, Arrow, SimpliSafe, First American and Alert 360. An AARP discount for AHS was recorded under senior_programs. An unsupported Culligan payment_assistance link was removed, and Brinks autopay_cancel was set to null because no public page supports it. Ring URLs were found in the Internet Archive CDX index and then read live. HomeServe payment-history features come from an archived payments FAQ (2026-03-11). Four merged or defunct entries were removed and noted in the surviving entries: Protect America went to Brinks Home, LifeShield to ADT, Nicor Home Solutions to Oncourse, and Security Partners to the Alarm.com dealer note. Ten entries were added: the Rollins brands MissQuito, OPC and Saela, plus SavATree, NaturaLawn, The Grounds Guys, Armadillo, Rayne Water, Mosquito Authority and Xcel HomeSmart. Xfinity Home was upgraded to detailed. There is no government roster for these industries. Completeness was checked against the scope list and the Rollins, Rentokil, Authority Brands, Neighborly and Frontdoor brand families. The detailed entries still depend on "call to cancel autopay" for most pest, lawn and warranty companies, because those companies publish no self-serve cancel page. Rebuild: python3 rosters/_raw/homesec/build.py, then python3 rosters/_raw/homesec/review_patch.py. REVIEW PASS 2 (2026-09-30, third agent; web search was still unavailable). An automated curl sweep checked all 420 URLs in the file. Nearly all non-200 results were bot blocks (ADT, Vivint www, HomeServe, SLWA, the Rentokil brands, Arlo, Sears, Service Experts, Knockout, Mosquito Authority, Wyze help) or login portals that return 500 or require JavaScript (lawngateway, xpress-pay, ServicePro). achosahomewarranty.com is NXDOMAIN, so Achosa's website was set to null. First American's FAQ moved to /faq. A keyword check read the pages behind the 140 detailed-entry links: 110 matched their field, and most of the 30 that did not are script-rendered help centers (ADT, Vivint, Bartlett) or login portals. Vivint articles were re-read through the Vivint knowledge-base API: autopay opt-out is by chat, and the cancellation policy has a 65+ medical/care-facility exception that waives the early termination fee (recorded in senior_programs). ADT's bill-explainer PDF (Internet Archive copy) confirmed 800-238-2727 and a remittance PO box. CenterPoint HSP was verified (Minnesota plans $18.95-$58.95/month). Utility-billed plans (SoCalGas/HomeServe, DTE surge, CenterPoint HSP) now point pay, autopay and assistance to the utility's own billing pages. The Guardian Protection autopay_cancel link, which only covered editing a card, was set to null. Added: Pye-Barker Fire & Safety (detailed, with remittance address and portals), Cox Homelife (existing customers only) and Canary. Rebuild: build.py, then review_patch.py (which reads review_data.py and review2_data.py). This pass also fixed a review_patch.py bug where a second p() call for the same entry overwrote the first call's notes_add. Detailed-tier link coverage before: view_bill 34%, pay_bill 51%, autopay_setup 26%, autopay_cancel 34%, statements_history 13%, paperless 3%, payment_assistance 49% (61 detailed). After: view_bill 39%, pay_bill 61%, autopay_setup 39%, autopay_cancel 47%, statements_history 20%, paperless 5%, payment_assistance 47% (64 detailed; One Call Alert, Galaxy Medical Alert and Diet Direct upgraded from roster). Method: web search was unavailable (session budget exhausted), so the pass used direct fetches only: each brand's sitemap/robots was crawled for billing, terms, return and FAQ pages; terms of service were mined for billing cycle, card-on-file/auto-renew, cancel-and-return-equipment rules (the medical-alert autopay_cancel equivalent) and statement availability; Zendesk help-center APIs were read for LogicMark and Aloe Care; JS-only pages (Alert1, MedicalAlert.org) were read from bundles or with a page renderer. Home-care franchise systems: full sitemaps were crawled for Home Instead (607 offices, 51k URLs), Comfort Keepers (456 offices), Visiting Angels (20k URLs), Senior Helpers (367), Home Helpers (333), Amada (144), SYNERGY, ComForCare, Homewatch, Interim, FirstLight and Always Best Care, and 400 sampled office homepages were scanned for pay/portal links. Findings: no franchise system has a national client bill-pay portal; the local office's scheduling system provides it. WellSky Personal Care (ClearCare) Family Room was confirmed at Home Instead, Comfort Keepers, Visiting Angels and Home Helpers offices; WellSky documents bill pay/split in Family Room. AxisCare's Client + Family Portal (view/pay invoices, autopay, billing history) was seen at Visiting Angels offices. Comfort Keepers offices are moving to Viv Technologies apps that show financial statements. One Senior Helpers office uses Vanco online bill pay. Amada and Nurse Next Door publish LTC-insurance direct billing (assignment of benefits). Still missing: rightathome.net, griswoldcare.com, lifefone.com and brightstarcare.com subpages block automated fetches (BrightStar and Griswold FAQs were read with a page renderer; Right at Home and LifeFone were not); Life Alert, GetSafe, ResponseNow, LifeProtect 24/7, Rescue Alert and Electronic Caregiver publish no billing docs (phone only); paperless billing is documented only by Lifeline, Guardian Medical Monitoring and Enhabit; no named 'CareInMotion Pay' product was found on any franchise or vendor site; per-office portals for the ~5,000 local franchise offices are not enumerated (one example office per brand is recorded); no new brands were added because none could be confirmed without search. All 165 unique URLs in the change set were status-checked: everything resolves except bot-blocked 403s (rightathome.net, griswoldcare.com, lifefone.com, brightstarcare.com, the LogicMark/Aloe Zendesk help centers) and transient timeouts (seniorhelpers.com, lifeprotect247.com) that load on retry or in a browser. Content spot-checked against the recorded notes for 40 entries (Medical Guardian, Bay Alarm, GetSafe, Lifeline, LogicMark, Aloe Care, LifeStation, UnaliWear, ResponseNow, QMedic, MedicAlert, LifeProtect 24/7, One Call, Alert1, LifeFone, Galaxy, Medical Care Alert, VRI, Home Instead, Visiting Angels, Right at Home, Comfort Keepers, BrightStar, Senior Helpers, Griswold, Home Helpers, FirstLight, SYNERGY, Always Best Care, Amada, Interim, Touching Hearts, Caring Senior Service, Active Day, Mom's Meals, BistroMD/Silver Cuisine, Magic Kitchen, Diet Direct, GoGoGrandparent, SilverRide); the backfilled claims held up (e.g., Visiting Angels two-week cancel notice, Medical Guardian PO Box and portal billing, Bay Alarm return address). Fixes: Right at Home read in a browser - the national footer links a WellSky Family Room login (rightathomehq.clearcareonline.com), the only franchise system with a system-level client portal link; FAQ invoicing/cancel/statement answers and the Ways To Pay guide added and the entry is now genuinely verified. LifeFone FAQ/portal read in a browser (cancel line 1-800-940-0262, billing stops when equipment is received, lifetime price guarantee). Alert1 mail-payment address added. Galaxy customer-care phone corrected and flagged as a Canadian (CAD-priced) provider. Comfort Keepers consumer toll-free line added. Payment processors filled for One Call (Shopify), Diet Direct (Shopify + Recharge), Medical Care Alert (BigCommerce), Galaxy (WooCommerce), Heart to Home (Magento + third-party processor). Duplicates/mergers: the separate 'Honor' record was removed; Honor Technology is Home Instead's parent and its care network bills through Home Instead offices/partners (noted on Home Instead). Silver Cuisine's closure into BistroMD was already recorded. Added: Homestyle Direct (detailed; national Medicaid/Medicare Advantage medically tailored meals, 115,000+ members, private pay by phone). Upgraded: Heart to Home Meals to detailed (its only U.S. outlet serves Eastern Massachusetts; terms give payment rules). HomeWell got its FAQ as help/payment-assistance link.
